fullPassage: There's a lot of scientific evidence demonstrating that focused attention leads to the reshaping of the brain. In animals rewarded for noticing sound (to hunt or to avoid being hunted for example), we find much larger auditory centers in the brain. In animals rewarded for sharp eyesight, the visual areas are larger. Brain scans of violinists provide more evidence, showing dramatic growth and expansion in regions of the cortex that represent the left hand, which has to finger the strings precisely, often at very high speed. Other studies have shown that the hippocampus, which is vital for spatial memory, is enlarged in taxi drivers. The point is that the physical architecture of the brain changes according to where we direct our attention and what we practice doing.

det.analysis: enlarge(동사) → is enlarged(수동태 과거분사): 해마가 '확대되는' 수동 관계이므로 be + p.p.
det.tip: 수동태: is + 과거분사(enlarged)

questions.passage: There's a lot of scientific evidence demonstrating that focused attention leads to the reshaping of the brain. In animals rewarded for noticing sound (to hunt or to avoid being hunted for example), we find much larger auditory centers in the brain. In animals rewarded for sharp eyesight, the visual areas are larger. Brain scans of violinists provide more evidence, showing dramatic growth and expansion in regions of the cortex that represent the left hand, which has to finger the strings precisely, often at very high speed. Other studies have shown that the hippocampus, which is vital for spatial memory, is enlarged in taxi drivers. The point is that the physical architecture of the brain changes according to where we direct our attention and what we practice doing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 주의와 연습이 뇌 구조를 바꿈
det.analysis:
❌ ① 수면: 본문에 수면 언급 없음

✅ ② 주의와 연습이 뇌의 물리적 구조를 바꿈: 동물·바이올린 연주자·택시 운전사 예시로 뇌가 쓰임에 따라 변함을 입증 ← 정답

❌ ③ 뇌 크기 차이: 종간 비교가 주제 아님

❌ ④ 바이올린 학습법: 바이올린은 예시일 뿐
det.tip: where we direct our attention and what we practice → 뇌 구조 변화

ch: 주의와 연습이 뇌의 물리적 구조를 바꾼다는 것

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 집중·연습에 따라 뇌 구조가 달라짐
det.analysis:
❌ ① 뇌 불변: 본문과 정반대

❌ ② 시각 > 청각: 본문은 우열을 가리지 않음

✅ ③ 집중하고 연습하는 것에 따라 뇌 구조가 달라짐: 글 전체 요지 ← 정답

❌ ④ 공간 기억 약화: 택시 운전사의 해마는 오히려 확대(enlarged)됨
det.tip: 요지 = 뇌는 쓰임에 따라 물리적으로 변한다

ch: 뇌는 태어난 후 전혀 변하지 않는다.
시각 능력이 청각 능력보다 항상 더 중요하다.
우리가 집중하고 연습하는 것에 따라 뇌 구조가 달라진다.
